align.name: task_complete_signal
align.reason: position dependent: as1 pads the unreachable epilogue after its infinite loop to a 32-byte boundary of .text, so the body is 36 words only when it starts at its image offset modulo 32 (35-45 words elsewhere; wholeprog README M8). The shadow unit is not laid out like retail yet, so a pad function is emitted before it

align.name: audio_queue_process
align.reason: position dependent, same mechanism as task_complete_signal: as1 pads the unreachable epilogue after the Rumble Pak thread's endless loop to a 32-byte boundary of .text (169 words only at its image offset modulo 32; 170 in the shadow unit otherwise). Its own group fixes the offset by file order; the shadow unit needs a pad

align.name: dma_wait_complete
align.reason: position dependent, same mechanism as task_complete_signal and audio_queue_process: the scheduler-client thread ends in an endless loop and as1 pads its unreachable epilogue to a 32-byte boundary of .text (105 words only at its image offset modulo 32; 103 in the shadow unit otherwise)

extern_data.name: D_8012E688
extern_data.reason: gfx_modes compiles the locked single object_render.c as context because sound_init stores this s64 cache with one shared lui, which needs a definition in the group's program; in the shadow unit the locked src/blob/object_render.c is the one definition

extern_data.name: D_80156958
extern_data.reason: controller_poll's two gStick stores share one lui, which needs D_80156958 defined in the group's program (w24d); in the shadow unit the group file is the one definition, the other units see it extern

data_align.name: D_8011AD90
data_align.reason: position dependent data (w20h cause 1): as1 shares one `lui at` across loads of a symbol defined in the unit only inside one 16-byte-aligned chunk of .data; retail's grouping of entity_render_setup's eight D_8011AD90 (Vec3[4]) loads proves the table sat at a .data offset = 0 mod 16 (= its image address 0x8011AD90 mod 16). Earlier files' .data put it at 72 in the shadow unit, so a .data pad is linked before the file that defines it. Also read by music_control (unmatched)
